validity.recommendation: Re-source or downgrade the 145 km length and 30 in diameter to inferred/blank; they are GEM-only figures with no independent corroboration. Treat the entry as the offshore-to-Berri gathering link, not a verified discrete 145 km / 30 in trunk line.
validity.researcher_notes:
EXISTENCE (confirmed): The physical infrastructure carrying gas to Berri Gas Plant is real and well documented. Fluor's Aramco Offshore Gas Gathering Project page states gas from 'three separate offshore fields in Safaniya, Marjan and Zuluf' is transported 'by pipeline to shore at Safaniya and Tanajib' and then 'along the coast to processing facilities previously constructed by Fluor at Berri, Shedgum and Ju'aymah,' with 'more than 150 miles of various diameter pipelines, primarily offshore.' Zawya (project update) independently confirms the Tanajib Gas Plant is part of the Marjan development and processes gas from Marjan/Zuluf. Both endpoints (Tanajib Gas Plant, Berri Gas Plant) are independently attested (Aramco/Argaam/attaqa, Arabic). So the entity is NOT a hallucination.

CLASSIFICATION (caveat, not reclass): Fluor describes a multi-line offshore GATHERING network (fields -> shore at Safaniya/Tanajib -> Berri/Shedgum/Ju'aymah), not a single point-to-point Tanajib->Berri transmission trunk. The gas reaching Berri is gathered offshore gas routed via Tanajib; modeling it as one discrete Tanajib->Berri line is a defensible simplification but the '150+ miles of various diameter' network does not map cleanly to a single 145 km / 30 in line.

SPEC (the real problem): The exact GEM values len=145 km and dia=30 in could NOT be corroborated by ANY independent source. They appear only on gem.wiki and in search snippets echoing it. Fluor gives '>150 miles various diameter' for the whole network (not a single 145 km line) and does not state a 30 in diameter for this link. The two gem.wiki reference citations (OPEC ASB2012 PDF and OPEC ASB2013 flipbook page 79) do NOT contain the strings 'Tanajib' or 'Berri' on verification (ASB2012 PDF: 200 but missing 'Tanajib'; ASB2013 page79: missing 'Berri', and now returns 403/402) — they are generic OPEC statistics bulletins that do not support this pipeline's specs. Note the unrelated Saipem 'Berri Downstream Pipeline' (30 in + 10 in) is CRUDE/condensate from Abu Ali Island to Khursaniyah/Juaymah — a different route and commodity, not this gas line; do not let its 30 in figure be mistaken as corroboration.

DUPLICATE (none found): No same-named roster duplicate. Other Berri-feed gas lines in the roster (P1916 Qatif North-Berri, P1906 Abqaiq-Berri, P1898/P1899 UBTG-Berri) are distinct origins/routes.

ATTRIBUTION: Owner = Saudi Aramco (100%) is consistent with all sources (Aramco-built/operated). FuelSource 'Tanajib Copmplex' is misspelled (should be 'Tanajib Complex' / Tanajib Gas Plant) and the upstream gas actually originates from offshore Marjan/Zuluf/Safaniya gathered via Tanajib. Endpoints (Persian Gulf coast/Tanajib -> Berri Gas Plant, Al Jubail, Eastern Province) are consistent with Fluor's routing.

fills.researcher_notes: Gas-to-Berri gathering infrastructure is built and gas is flowing to Berri/Shedgum/Ju'aymah (Fluor completed); Tanajib Gas Plant onstream per Zawya/Argaam. 'operating' is supportable for the link, though the discrete 145 km/30 in trunk line as modeled is not independently verified.
Fluor describes the system as gas gathering/transport (Safaniya/Marjan/Zuluf offshore gas -> Tanajib/Safaniya shore -> Berri/Shedgum/Ju'aymah gas plants). Commodity = Gas confirmed.
Fluor confirms gas comes to shore at Tanajib (Persian Gulf coast, Eastern Province) and is routed to Berri Gas Plant (near Al Jubail), consistent with the recorded endpoints.

145 km could not be independently corroborated. Only gem.wiki (and snippets echoing it) state 145 km. Fluor gives '>150 miles various diameter' for the entire offshore gathering network, not a single 145 km line. OPEC ASB2012/ASB2013 citations on the wiki do not contain Tanajib/Berri. Leave blank/inferred rather than cite an unverified figure.

30 in could not be independently corroborated for this gas line. Fluor says 'various diameter' without a 30 in figure for this segment. The 30 in figure that surfaces in searches belongs to the unrelated Saipem 'Berri Downstream Pipeline' (crude/condensate, Abu Ali Island route), not this gas line. No independent source agrees with 30 in here.

Value 'Tanajib Copmplex' is misspelled (should be 'Tanajib Complex'/'Tanajib Gas Plant') AND substantively imprecise: per Fluor/Zawya the gas originates from offshore Marjan/Zuluf/Safaniya fields and is gathered/processed via Tanajib. Recommend correcting spelling and clarifying FuelSource as Marjan/Zuluf offshore gas (via Tanajib Gas Plant). Not staging an unverified replacement string here.
Saudi Aramco is the owner/operator of the entire offshore-to-Berri gathering system (Fluor was the EPC contractor for Aramco). 100% Aramco ownership is consistent across all sources.

summary: P1904 Tanajib-Berri: gathering infrastructure to Berri is real (Fluor, Zawya) and Aramco-owned, but the discrete 145 km / 30 in 'Tanajib->Berri' trunk line is a GEM-only spec with NO independent corroboration; verdict=concern (spec). FuelSource misspelled; wiki's OPEC citations don't mention the pipeline.
